rationale: The agent failed to confirm the return action before performing it. According to the policy, the agent must confirm with the user before taking any order-changing action. In this case, the user initially wanted to return the less expensive tablet, but after potential confirmation needs were raised, there was a shift in intention. Not confirming these changes with the user led to the application of the original order return, which did not reflect the user's latest intentions. This misstep puts the action outside the permissible procedure, thus I assess this conversation as a fail.
